title: Personnel of the Buddy Doyle recordings
summary: Asked who played on the Buddy Doyle sessions, Slim says he was on them and names Jack Kelly and Fred McDowell, whom he later toured overseas with.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: You met him in Memphis? Yep. Well, I'm very interested in the blues scene in Memphis. There are some guys who made recordings which are somewhat mysterious. I remember that you told somebody you know the personnel of the Buddy Doyle recordings. That's right. I was on them. You took part. I was on them.
And who else played with you? That's right.
Raymond Payne. Raymond Payne? Yeah. Fred McDowell.

Do you know Fred McDowell? Yeah, I mentioned him. Well, Fred McDowell. You know, I was overseas with him. Well, Scenna does rank, Ruth. I got some, uh... What did you say? I was overseas with him. Fred McDowell. I got some Christian brothers, uh... Oh, yes. Yes, yes, yes. You mean some of you see a guy who played? Oh, hell yeah. You know.
And, uh, I think you also mentioned a guy named Willie Tango. Did he play with you in that session? Oh, oh. Tango? No, Homestead. I quit, but I was a good one. You know, I'm old.
I know old guys. You know, I'm glad you don't drink.
I've been knowing him since I was a kid.
